info.title: Cisco Crosswork Assurance
info.description: Network performance monitoring, session analytics, active testing, alerting, and service-assurance data API for the Cisco Crosswork Assurance platform (formerly Accedian Skylight / Cisco Provider Connectivity Assurance).
info.x-itential-curated: Trimmed to 97 of 253 upstream operations covering monitored-object CRUD, threshold profiles, session filters, alerting policies/alerts, metrics & reporting, active testing (TCP throughput + session trace), data export, time window exclusions, predictions, and connector/ingestion status. See the repo README for the full scope and the full spec.

TimeRange.description: A time range specified by before and after in epoch time. Both before and after are inclusive to the specified value.

MetaExclude.description: An array that allows blacklisting one or more metadata criteria. Each key in the array must correspond to a given key in the MetaFilter portion of the request. This exclusion is a logical NOT for any values belonging to the metadata criteria listed in this request. For example, if the MetaFilter is: {"region":["montreal","ottawa"], "group":["radio"]}, we can have a MetaExclude of the form ["region"]. This would result in a request that includes any records that are of group "radio" AND NOT in regions Ottawa or Montreal.

MetaFilter.description: An object that allows filtering on arbitrary metadata criteria and their values.  The keys in the map are associated with metadata categories and the value array  corresponds to a set of whitelist filter-in values for that category. The logical  semantics associated with this structure are conditional-AND across metadata criteria (keys) and conditional-OR across the values contained within the value array. For example, {"region":["montreal","ottawa"], "group":["radio"]} will match all records that are of group "radio" AND from the region "montreal" OR "ottawa"

metadata.description: Inclusion and exclusion filters for metadata records

assetIdFilter.description: Set of one or more ids to be used by the filter to identify required metric records

assetTypeFilter.description: Set of asset names associated with the filter

DerivedMetricsQueryContext.description: Hints indicating how the query may be returned

sorted.description: Indicates whether the response should return grouped by queries in ascending or descending order. Only applicable to grouped queries.

numResults.description: Number of results to return in grouped queries. A non-positive integer for this value implies there is no result limit. Only applicable to grouped queries.

DerivedMetricsGroupByResponse.description: JSON API compliant wrapper for the groupby response

DerivedMetricsGroupByReport.description: The rendered response structure from the metric query

DerivedMetricsGroupedResultEntryParamete.description: Describes filtering criteria used for a particular query that uses a grouping

DerivedMetricsAggregateV3Request.description: JSON API compliant wrapper for the aggregate query

DerivedMetricsAggregateV3Config.description: The necessary request parameters for the metric api call

interval.description: Time boundary for the metrics under consideration using the ISO-8601 standard

granularity.description: the granularity for timeseries in ISO-8601 duration format, or ALL

metrics.description: A set of identifiers that considers specific metrics based on the provided information

DerivedMetricsAggregateV3Response.description: JSON API compliant wrapper for the aggregate response

DerivedMetricsAggregateV3Report.description: The rendered response structure from the metric query

DerivedMetricsTimeseriesResult.description: Describes series data prefixed with the filter criteria that were used to generate the output

prev.description: URL to fetch results before those contained in the current response

next.description: URL to fetch results after those contained in the current response

hour.description: When the report interval should end at. Jobs are run when system is not busy so the hour is a best effort. Can't be 'star'

dayOfMonth.description: On what date of the month should this run. Note that if you wish to run this once a month for the LAST month of data, you should specify the 1 (st) of every month with a duration of `P1M`. You can only specify dayOfMonth or dayOfWeek. If both are filled in, your request will be rejected.

dayOfWeek.description: On what day of the week to schedule the job on. 0 is sunday, 1 is monday, 2 is tuesday, 3 is wednesday, 4 si thursday, 5 is friday, 6 is saturday

duration.description: The duration of the query. P1M means 1 month from the time before expected execution of the report schedule.

includeOnlyCleanData.description: If true, includes records marked clean record flag

includeBusyHour.description: If true, includes records marked with busy hour flag

includeMaintenanceWindow.description: If true, includes records marked with maintenance flag

includeMetadata.description: Include metadata key-values that you want to filter on

objectType.description: We must know the object type the export is for. We cannot run a single report against multiple object types in this version.

items.description: Please note that direction `2`, aka `RT` is a special experimental feature for TWAMP. It must be used alone for this version and cannot be mixed with other directions.

columns.description: Columns you wish to see in the exported dataset, can be dimensions, metrics, metadata

emails.description: List of emails that will get the report

type.description: The metric you want to group on

granularity.description: The granularity to be applied to the aggregation. Note that PT1H is only allowed when the interval is less than 1 day

ExportThresholdModel.description: Model for Export Threshold Crossing columns, which will be a boolean type

comparator.description: The metric value can be greater or lesser (and equal) according to the operator

metric.description: The metric you want to test the threshold against

value.description: Value for the metric to compare to

ExportConfigurationMeta.description: Resuable block for users to see permission properties for a resource

GetAllExportReportModel.description: Returns all the export reports for a configuration

format.description: The format the payload is in.

size.description: Size of the payload attribute in bytes

compression.description: The type of compression applied to the payload

payload.description: This is the dataset stored in BASE64. You must decode the BASE64 and then decompress it using the compression format defined in the 'compression' attribute. Example: `cat <file>.csv.gz.b64 | base64 -d | gzip -d > file.csv`

OAuth2.description: OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code flow with PKCE (S256 code_challenge_method), replayed as a Bearer token on the Authorization header. Register/locate the AnalyticsUI client_id in the tenant's IAM console (Applications section, tenant-admin role), then complete the PKCE authorization_code exchange against the tenant's IAM authority (auth.{deployment}.{domain}) and send the resulting access_token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. OpenAPI's oauth2 flow object has no native PKCE flag, hence this description.
